limitations: Table 6 uses average activation energies although Table 4 reports conversion-dependent energies; a constant pair replay is not the complete isoconversional predictor.
These curves contributed to source parameter estimation, so matching them is reproduction, not external holdout.
No reverse pressure-dependent rate, interfacial area evolution or same-material brick kinetics is supplied.
Printed 0.1 C granularity is not experimental uncertainty.
Full initial sample temperature and conversion are not reported. Cold-anchor sensitivity is a declared calculation, not source data.
